rules.declaration: Consume the live unsuppressed pending record before the first candidate die of the chosen original roll is generated. No Action or Reaction is added or spent for this choice. Natural attack1 still misses and20 critically doubles only actual damage dice,not the flat insight or damage modifiers. Saves use final total without generic natural shifts; on death saves natural1 still adds two failures and natural20 still restores1HP, otherwise compare total including10 against10. rules.stacking: Same-name copies never stack. Genuine distinct source dice benefits may apply only within their exact one-bonus-die/source rules. Core ability/PB modifiers are the base formula, not displaced by the insight. Reserve/consume at legal declaration even if its flat amount is superseded by a stronger existing benefit; do not reclaim it after failure. Source-qualified suppression disallows declaration but does not pause deadline or refund a consumed lineage. Once attached to a committed roll its snapshot persists through reroll/source ending; no suppression hook rewrites already committed dice.
